antibiotics administrated specifically during the first week of life
broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected neonatal infection
Antibiotic courses later in the first year of life
cohort: 436 term infants (151 receiving broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected neonatal infection (AB+) and 285 healthy controls (AB-))
finding: Infants receiving antibiotics in the first week of life had lower weight-for-age and length-for-age increase in the first year of life compared to those who did not receive antibiotics, while later antibiotic courses in the first year were associated with increased weight gain.
